# `mlangd-mla` manual

```roff
.TH MLANGD-MLA 1 "September 2026" "MLang" "User Commands"
.SH NAME
mlangd-mla \- self-hosted MLang Language Server Protocol server
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B mlangd-mla
[\fB\-v\fR|\fB\-\-version\fR]
[\fB\-\-enable\-log\fR]
[\fB\-\-log\-level\fR \fILEVEL\fR]
[\fB\-\-log\-dir\fR \fIDIR\fR]
[\fB\-\-log\-color\fR|\fB\-\-log\-colors\fR]
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B mlangd-mla
is the self-hosted MLang language server. It speaks LSP over stdio and provides
the primary editor integration for MLang source files.
.PP
When started without
.BR \-\-version ,
the process immediately enters its stdio JSON-RPC loop.
.PP
For document and range formatting, the server searches from the source file's
directory toward the workspace root for the nearest
.IR .mlang-format
file. Document formatting honors all supported style keys, including
.BR IndentWidth ,
.BR SpaceAfterComma ,
.BR SpaceAfterColon ,
.BR SpaceAroundOperators ,
and
.BR EnsureTrailingNewline .
Range formatting does not apply the whole-file trailing-newline setting.
Formatting is implemented inside the server and does not require a separate
.BR mlang-format (1)
process.
.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.BR \-v ", " \-\-version
Print the tool version and exit.
.TP
.B \-\-enable\-log
Enable internal file logging.
.TP
.B \-\-log\-level \fILEVEL\fR
Select the log level. Supported values are
.BR DEBUG ,
.BR INFO ,
.BR ERROR ,
.BR WARN ,
and
.BR VERBOSE .
.TP
.B \-\-log\-dir \fIDIR\fR
Write the log file below
.IR DIR .
The default log directory is
.IR /tmp ,
and the file name is
.IR mlangd-mla.log .
.TP
.BR \-\-log\-color ", " \-\-log\-colors
Enable colored log-level tags in the log file output.
.SH EXAMPLES
.nf
mlangd-mla --version
mlangd-mla --enable-log --log-level INFO --log-dir /tmp
mlangd-mla --enable-log --log-level VERBOSE --log-colors
.fi
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR mlangd (1),
.BR mlang-format (1),
.BR mlang (1)
```
